info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Loan Products API
info.description: The Loan Products API provides access to a comprehensive list of loan products offered by the financial institution. Utilizing this endpoint, users can retrieve detailed information about various loan options available, including terms, interest rates, and eligibility criteria. This API is essential for developers building applications in the banking or fintech sectors, allowing them to facilitate product comparisons or enable informed borrowing decisions. Typical consumers include application developers, financial advisors, and end-users seeking to explore loan offerings.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of available loan products.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch all available loan products, including their features and terms. It provides essential information for making informed borrowing decisions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information about available loan products. It may include filters or specific parameters to refine the results based on user needs.

200.description: Successfully retrieved list of loan products.
